dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform dark-grey median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast white point anomaly located on the anterior dorsal surface of the melon.

other_distinctive_markers: Centrally located, dark-pigmented blowhole visible as a high-contrast oval on the midline of the head.
